title: Canadian Taleggio Gratin
description: A rich and creamy Canadian-inspired gratin featuring the Italian cheese Taleggio.
instructions: Cook Canadian bacon in a skillet over medium heat until crispy, about 5-7 minutes. Set aside.
In a medium saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Whisk in flour to make a roux, cooking for 1-2 minutes.
Slowly pour in heavy cream, whisking constantly. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes or until thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in Taleggio cheese until melted. Season with salt and nutmeg.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, arrange Canadian bacon in a single layer.
Pour Taleggio cream over the bacon and top with a sprinkle of grated nutmeg.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the sauce is bubbly.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
